open_points.subject: answer_request
open_points.text: The body is one JSON-RPC 2.0 message, read only after the size and token checks.
open_points.other_text: The id of every response is the body's id member when the body is one JSON object whose id is a string or an integer, and null otherwise; reading it checks nothing and decides nothing.
open_points.question: For a request rejected by the size check, must the body remain unread, or must it be read to preserve a string or integer id in the error response?

open_points.subject: serve_kernel
open_points.text: any other method on that path is answered 405, any other path 404
open_points.other_text: a request carrying an Origin header 403
open_points.question: What status must be returned when a request both carries an Origin header and uses another method on the endpoint or another path?

open_points.subject: serve_kernel
open_points.text: MUST read at most one byte more of a request body than the imported RELEASE_CEILING_SURFACE_REQUEST_BYTES_MAX constant allows, so an oversized request still reaches answer_request and is refused there;
open_points.other_text: Only a POST to the path equal to the imported MCP_ENDPOINT_PATH constant reaches answer_request; any other method on that path is answered 405, any other path 404, and a request carrying an Origin header 403, each without a body and without calling answer_request;
open_points.question: Must every oversized request reach answer_request, or only an oversized POST to the configured path without an Origin header?
